purpose: Freeze the minimum end-to-end immutable hash chain that must bind a replay-certified CLEAR_NO_ACTION continuity witness to the physical SHORT_MOMENTUM NC-T01 result without changing existing decision/run schemas.

binds: cross-market duplicate diagnostics and blocker state

factorSnapshotHash.continuityConsequence: If replay/continuity immutable refs are inserted into sourceManifest before factor-snapshot hashing, snapshot_hash changes when the continuity receipt/replay identity changes.

doesNotDirectlyBind: continuityReceiptId/receiptHash unless separately threaded into decision input
decisionHash.consequence: Two different valid CLEAR_NO_ACTION continuity receipts producing identical factors/evaluation can share the same decisionHash.

shadowAccountingHash.caveat: shadowRunReceipt does not preserve the explicit excludedSymbols list itself; orchestration-level exclusions and A1 batch identity remain stronger full-universe provenance.

runFingerprintHash.continuityConsequence: Current runFingerprintHash is not sufficient proof of continuity-receipt identity when decision values are unchanged.

predictionSnapshotHash.continuityConsequence: It inherits the same limitation unless continuity identity alters the decision/run objects.

persistenceBatchHash.binds: All persistence operations including complete factor snapshot rows and their source_manifest_json plus rowDigests.
persistenceBatchHash.continuityConsequence: Once immutable replay/continuity refs are in factor sourceManifest, persistenceBatchHash cryptographically changes with those refs even if decisionHash remains identical.

ncT01ReceiptHash.futureBuilderRequirement: The frozen minimal physical contract requires hashing every schema field except receiptHash before finalization.
ncT01ReceiptHash.conclusion: Existing V0.1 schema is sufficient if immutable typed digest refs are required by acceptance; no new top-level field is launch-critical.

riskIfUnrefined: A physical runner could satisfy the JSON schema while placing only weak/free-text source identifiers or runFingerprintHash in sourceGenerationRefs. In that case a continuity receipt could change without changing the claimed physical result identity, weakening S22-T15 provenance despite apparently valid output.

frozenMinimumTypedSourceGenerationRefs.valueRule: Canonical merged-main System2 per-strategy policy-fingerprint receipt hash for SHORT_MOMENTUM after S22-T06~T10 acceptance.
Exact current a1SymbolSnapshotBatch.batchHash used by the physical run.
Exact witness replayWindow.replayHash from the selected RAW PIT revisions/session set.
Shared D03-compatible sourceHistoryHash for the exact witness window.
Exact validated CLEAR_NO_ACTION continuity receipt hash.
Exact continuityTransformHash. For first RAW CLEAR_NO_ACTION witness this must describe no price transform rather than an adjusted-series transform.
Exact witness symbol factor snapshot_hash after continuity/replay refs are included in source_manifest_json.
Exact dry-built/read-only physical Limited Shadow persistenceBatch.batchHash whose factor rows contain the continuity/replay provenance.
Exact daily Limited Shadow orchestrationHash; this is the primary existing top-level execution/result identity.
Exact shadowAccountingHash for the full eligible/accounted denominator.

candidateUniverseProvenanceMinimum: witness symbol and its exact evaluation state
explicit statement that uncertified symbols remain INCOMPLETE/denominator-accounted rather than removed to manufacture executability

receiptHashRule.canonicalization: Canonical deterministic object serialization; hash all receipt fields except receiptHash.
requiredBehavior: Changing any typed sourceGenerationRef changes receiptHash.
receiptHashRule.s22T15Interpretation: For NC-T01 V0.1 the receiptHash is the final immutable receipt/result-root hash, while ORCHESTRATION_SHA256 is the physical strategy-execution root referenced inside it.

insufficiencyRules: runFingerprintHash alone is NOT sufficient continuity provenance.
decisionHash alone is NOT sufficient continuity provenance.
predictionSnapshotHash alone is NOT sufficient continuity provenance.
A string continuityReceiptId without its immutable digest is NOT sufficient.
A sourceGenerationRef that is free-text without type+digest semantics is NOT sufficient.
A continuity receipt stored only in an artifact but not included in the receiptHash dependency graph is NOT sufficient.
requiredRegressions: Same factors/evaluation, different valid continuity receipt hash -> decisionHash may remain equal but persistenceBatchHash, orchestrationHash and final NC-T01 receiptHash MUST change.
Same continuity receipt, one replay source-row/revision changes -> replay/sourceHistory/factorSnapshot/persistenceBatch/orchestration/final receipt identities MUST invalidate or change.
Same execution, one excluded-symbol provenance change -> A1/universe/orchestration/final receipt identity MUST change; runFingerprint alone cannot mask it.
Remove CONTINUITY_RECEIPT_SHA256 from sourceGenerationRefs -> physical PASS prohibited.
Replace ORCHESTRATION_SHA256 with runFingerprintHash-only provenance -> physical PASS prohibited.
ReceiptHash recomputation over all fields except receiptHash must exactly match stored receiptHash.

buildLane: Do not mutate the existing generic decision schema solely to satisfy the first NC-T01 witness.
Thread immutable replay/continuity refs into factor sourceManifest before factor snapshot hashing.
Expose exact factor snapshot hash, persistenceBatchHash and orchestrationHash to the NC-T01 receipt builder.
Build typed deterministic sourceGenerationRefs and candidateUniverseProvenance before final receiptHash.
Keep the read-only/artifact-only NC-T01 path free of actual D1 mutation.
auditLane: Independently recompute the entire hash chain from artifact payloads.
Reject any physical PASS where a mutable/free-text source reference substitutes for a digest.

dependencyOrder: CORR-004 exact expected-session repair + physical exact-window witness
reasonNoNewCorrection: No physical NC-T01 implementation has yet claimed PASS. The gap is found while the implementation contract is still pending, so it should refine BUILD_LANE acceptance rather than open a defect against a nonexistent completed runner.
